title.quote: Computational Tracking of Cell Origins Using CellSexID from Single-Cell Transcriptomes
title.justification: This is the paper title printed on the first page.
title.value: Computational Tracking of Cell Origins Using CellSexID from Single-Cell Transcriptomes

extractions.description: Introduces and empirically evaluates CellSexID, a software framework whose trained classifiers and consensus feature-selection procedure infer cell sex and thereby cell origin from single-cell transcriptomes.

type.quote: Here, we introduce CellSexID, a computational framework that leverages sex as a surrogate marker for cell origin inference. Using a machine learning model trained on single-cell transcriptomic data
type.justification: The paper trains and evaluates models on multiple public and newly generated datasets and reports numerical results.
